clips.description: drawn from below the view, right hand on the pistol grip, left hand on the fore-grip, a settle
breathing (frame 0 = the hip pose the game measures: HipGripLocation / HipRotation)
carried low across the body, muzzle down to the left, marked bob
one round: the bolt slams forward and back, short kick and settle

automatic fire, loop of 30 frames with 11 Fire events (11 rounds/s at play rate 1; PlayRate scales the rate): the bolt and its knob shuttle at every round, kick per round with a periodic climb and shudder
left hand presses the latch and pulls the drum down (MagOut), stows it, brings a full drum up and seats it (MagIn), pulls the cocking knob back (Charge)

the empty drum pulled down (MagOut) and let fall (MagDrop: the drum bone is hidden from there, the game may drop SM_Ammo_MitrailletteDrum from socket_drum), a full drum seated (MagIn), a hard charge (Charge)
the trigger pulled on an empty drum (DryClick)
rolled to show the drum, the receiver and the compensator
empty: the knob pulled on nothing (Empty), a look, thrown to the right and down (Release)

moving_parts.bolt: open bolt: rests to the rear (cocked); at every Fire it is forward on the event frame and back on the next one (the knob on top runs with it); Charge pulls it back past the rest and lets it catch
moving_parts.mag_latch: pressed forward by the left thumb before MagOut
moving_parts.drum: rigid drum; Reload / ReloadEmpty move it with the left hand (hidden by scale 0 while out of the gun and out of view)

bolt.type: open bolt, rests to the rear (cocked)

magazine.insertion: from below in front of the trigger guard, held by the latch (bone mag_latch)

rules.bAllowAiming: false (no aim clip, fired from the hip like the machine gun)
rules.RateOfFire: FireLoop: 11 Fire events per 1.0 s loop (play rate 1)
rules.ShellEject: SM_Mitraillette_Casing at every Fire from socket_eject toward socket_eject_dir

notes: Fictional 1920s drum sub-machine gun (Thompson 1921 / Suomi spirit): walnut stock, pistol grip and vertical fore-grip, blued receiver, finned barrel, slotted compensator, brass knob, latch and drum key; open bolt; 50 round drum from below.

FireLoop: 30 frames, 11 Fire events (frames 0, 3, 5, 8, 11, 14, 16, 19, 22, 25, 27): 11 rounds/s at play rate 1; the loop is seamless (frame 30 = frame 0); cut it anywhere (the C++ can blend to Idle when the trigger is released).
Reload: MagOut, MagIn, Charge (the drum kept); ReloadEmpty: MagOut, MagDrop (drum let fall, hidden), MagIn, Charge.
No aim clips (fired from the hip like the machine gun); Discard added like every v2 pack.

coordinate_system.blender: +X weapon forward, +Z up, -Y right side; the bean looks along -Y, its right side is -X
coordinate_system.unreal: convert_scene + convert_scene_unit, import scale 1; a weapon point (x, y, z) m -> (x, -y, z) * 100 cm

fp_framing.aim: none: the sub-machine gun is fired from the hip (no AimIdle clip; bAimPoseValid stays false)
fp_framing.note: HipGripLocation / HipRotation reproduce this camera exactly (Idle frame 0 = hip pose, socket_grip_r = the pistol grip).

fire_sequence.note: FireLoop repeated while the trigger is held (seamless: frame 30 = frame 0), cut anywhere to Idle; Fire is one round. Eject SM_Mitraillette_Casing at every Fire from socket_eject.

M_Mitraillette_Wood.orm_channels: R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metallic (linear)

M_Mitraillette_Drum.orm_channels: R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metallic (linear)

unreal_import.actor_attachment: Both Bean and weapon actor roots use the same world transform; do not attach the weapon to the hand a second time.
unreal_import.textures: manifest.materials[M_*].textures by label: BaseColor (sRGB), Normal (DirectX, green down), ORM (AO / roughness / metallic, linear); a material without textures (lenses) keeps the material of the FBX import
unreal_import.statics: exports/Static/*.fbx: pivot bottom centre, UCX hulls in the file (import with collision from the file)
